title.narrative: SME Competitiveness Support Programme - the former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia

description.narrative: The project will strengthen competitiveness of the local SMEs by incentivising the SMEs in undertaking investments in industrial premises, equipment, software, improvement of the enterprise management systems and general upgrading SMEs. It inlcudes : (i) dedicated credit lines to SMEs through partner financial institutions (PFIs) coupled with (ii) investment incentives, and (iii) technical assistance for Programme Implementation to support the provision of loans .
